# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> A spacious 3 bedroom semi detached family home boasting many extras and ideally located in a well established residential area within walking distance of schools, shops, pharmacies, restaurants and within easy access of Dundalk town centre and the M1 Motorway. Features include:- on-site parking, attractive rear yard, rockery area, elite fencing front and rear.
